title: Octus data and credit intelligence available in Legora
summary: Octus credit intelligence is becoming available inside Legora. Benchmark deal terms, speed up restructuring diligence, and support mandate pitches, all cited to the source.
body_markdown:
Legora today announced an integration with Octus, the leading information and data provider on the global credit markets.


The Octus MCP Connector™ brings Octus' proprietary, source-cited credit intelligence, including covenant data, court filings, and deal documents, directly into Legora's agentic workflows, so you can stay on one platform instead of switching tools.


Working on distressed credits, restructurings and leveraged finance deals requires spending as much time chasing context as it does reading documents. The intelligence that helps win a mandate, understand lender dynamics and support structuring often lives outside the platform where the legal work itself happens, which means switching tools, re-entering context and losing momentum mid-matter.


That friction is going away. Through the Octus MCP Connector, Legora now connects directly to Octus' credit intelligence and data, which includes expert reporting, company financials, covenant and restructuring data, deal documents and court filings, enabling new workflows like:


-


**Benchmarking deal terms in real time.** Pull covenant data across high yield bonds, broadly syndicated loans and direct lending deals to check proposed terms against market-standard precedent while drafting or negotiating.


-


**Speeding up restructuring diligence.** Bring credit situation summaries, bankruptcy analysis, and court filings directly into a matter, instead of re-running the same research in a separate platform.


-


**Supporting mandate pitches.** Surface advisor histories and sponsor relationships to help identify and prepare for new restructuring or leveraged finance mandates.


"Legora is bringing the best data together with the best technology, across every practice area. Octus is exactly the kind of specialist, source-cited data that attorneys rely upon for credit intelligence, and now it’s available directly in Legora,” says Melanie Brown, Head of Legal Data, Legora.


“Restructuring and leveraged finance attorneys must have access to the most comprehensive credit intelligence and data in the age of AI to get answers they can act on and stand behind. The Octus MCP Connector opens up our source-cited credit intelligence, backed by the Octus Trifecta's nearly 300 financial analysts, legal analysts and journalists, to your agent directly inside Legora,” says Ben Kovacka, Head of Direct Data Services at Octus.


The integration will be available to customers with an Octus License later this month. Reach out to your Legora representative for access.


**About Legora**
Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.


**About Octus**
Founded in 2013, Octus is the essential credit intelligence, data and workflow provider for the world’s leading buy-side firms, investment banks, law firms and advisory firms. By surrounding deep human expertise with proven technology, data and AI tools, Octus unlocks powerful truths that fuel decisive action across financial markets. Visit[octus.com](https://octus.com/) to learn more.
